# The Go share of std (TestStdGoShareOnlyFalls; NP4f, owner q202: std's
# computation is Ergo alone, and std binds Go's library through import go as
# a user does). One row per std extern whose Go target is in the Ergo
# runtime (ergo.local/prototype/runtime/...): `package<TAB>name<TAB>class`,
# or `package<TAB>name<TAB>class<TAB>unit`. The class is provider (a
# runtime primitive, Go stays), host (a host leaf Go stays for now), library
# (a call of Go's library, moves to import go), language (a slice, Map or
# string operation, moves to PRIM's IR operations), computation (moves to
# Ergo source) or type (a host type, follows its functions). A library,
# computation or language row names the unit that moves it. The test reads
# the checked std packages: every such extern has a row and every row an
# extern, and no class may hold more rows than its ceiling in
# stdGoShareCeiling, which only falls.
